title: Resume preview — the top card gets out of the way

steps.path: Type /resume in the message box, then click any conversation in the list
steps.headline: Pick a conversation in Resume and scroll up — does the top card slide away, and return when you scroll down?
steps.changed: Scrolling up through the conversation on the right slides the card at the top out of sight. Scrolling down slides it back.
steps.measured: 260 ms slide, after 6 px of scrolling in one direction
steps.notice: Pressing Load older at the top keeps the card hidden. Picking a different conversation always brings the card back.
steps.risk: The card holds the rename and tag buttons, so reaching them means scrolling down a little first. While its tag panel is open, the card stays put.
